posts.title: A free account now includes 10 tasks a day and every category
posts.description: Registered KipFire accounts get 10 free tasks a day across all six categories. Guests get 5 a day. Premium stays unlimited.
posts.body:
A free KipFire account now covers more of the app.

## What a free account includes

You get 10 tasks a day. Those 10 can come from any category: Funny, Challenges, Questions, Would You Rather, Hot Take, or Inner Me. It is one shared limit, not 10 from each category.

## What guests get

Without an account, you get 5 tasks a day, and only Funny and Challenges. After the fifth task, the app offers a free account for the full 10 and the rest of the categories.

## What Premium is for

Premium removes the daily limit. The categories themselves are open on a free account.

The allowance refreshes on a rolling window, not at midnight.

posts.title: KipFire is on the App Store
posts.description: KipFire is available for iPhone and iPad. Open it, get one short prompt, film your reaction, and post it.
posts.body:
KipFire is on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.

The app gives you one short card to film: a question, a challenge, a hot take, a would-you-rather, a funny line, or an honest line about you. You react on camera. The card sits on the video. The video stays on your phone.

Android is not out yet.

Search for KipFire on the App Store, or use the download button on this site.
